name: Windfolk
description: Beings who gave Baishya a vision of the birth of Ugin and the Elder Dragons.

description_citations.text: "Baishya". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gauzy windfolk emerge from the snow and Baishya faints trying to hear them; Naiva grabs her spear, thinking they are a threat.
timeline.quote: The windfolk came to warn us, not to hurt us.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya says the windfolk called her up to give a message for Grandmother.
timeline.quote: They called me up here to give me a message for Grandmother.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya climbs the Eternal Ice with Naiva, survives an avalanche and goblins, and receives a vision from the Windfolk.
timeline.quote: Together, they survived an avalanche and an attack by goblins.

citation.text: "Baishya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Naiva accompanied Baishya up the Eternal Ice; they survived an avalanche and goblins and met Windfolk who gave Baishya a vision.
timeline.quote: Together, they survived an avalanche and an attack by goblins.

citation.text: "Naiva", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Gauzy, tentacle-haired air elementals who come to Baishya to warn her and pass on a message.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.
